title: Rule-based branching — Conditional Workflow Router
description:
The conditional workflow router makes pipelines smart: instead of a fixed chain, each step's outcome decides what runs next — success goes one way, a particular error goes another, a low-confidence result triggers verification. It is the difference between a script and a strategy. The router's rules are explicit, testable, and logged, so a workflow's path through the decision tree can be replayed and audited like everything else.

This record documents the rule-based branching approach: Express next-step rules as readable conditions on the previous step's structured output.
